CustomField.description: Minimum number of child rows required for Repeater and Table sections. Passed as min to c-flow-form-repeat and c-flow-data-table, which enforce the floor and gate delete actions. Leave blank for no minimum.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The fewest rows a user must have in this repeater or table. Users cannot delete below this count; leave blank to set no minimum.
CustomField.label: Min
